title: The 5 Heaviest Organs in Your Body, Ranked (#1 Is Wrapped Around You)

scenes.text: The heaviest organ you own isn't inside you. It's wrapped around you.
Number five: the heart. About ten ounces, and it never takes a break.
scenes.label: Heart · ~10 oz

scenes.text: Number four: the lungs. Together about two and a half pounds, mostly air and tiny sacs.
scenes.label: Lungs · ~2.5 lb

scenes.text: Number three: the brain. About three pounds, and it runs on roughly a light bulb's worth of power.
scenes.label: Brain · ~3 lb

scenes.text: Number two: the liver. About three and a half pounds, the heaviest organ inside your body.
scenes.label: Liver · ~3.5 lb

scenes.text: Number one: your skin. Up to ten pounds, and it covers you from head to toe.
scenes.label: Skin · up to 10 lb

description:
The five heaviest organs in the human body, ranked by average weight.
Number one isn't inside you at all, and the liver beats the brain.
Which of these surprised you most?
first_comment: Did you guess skin? Which body ranking should we do next?
